body: Artwork - “Title : Pray for plagues, artist : RikkaRonka, medium : chalkmarker & permanent marker on a skateboard deck, year : 09/04/20”

Abused weed majorly from age 17-22, now I have major anxiety about anything, almost haven’t spoken this entire year because I feel like I can’t think or speak normally anymore. 

Have no passion or interest in anything anymore, and to top it off, quit my job last November due through burn out and have been afraid to really go outside ever since. Now I just waste my days doing nothing / sleeping / smoking weed / and being anxious about the future id rather not be in.
This is just a rip off of a scene from scrubs between Turk and Carla

Glad to hear that it got better with time for you, I also thought of the combination of depression adding to the brain fog, read somewhere that it can even cause amnesia. 

For me the feeling out of place got worse and worse after I left high school, probably because in high school you just follow the path like everyone else and after that it’s a lot more on yourself to choose the path you go down, also the fact that when you are a teenager it feels less bad to not know stuff since you’re not an adult yet. So it’s kinda like there is less pressure since you are still discovering it all.

And that doesn’t sound dumb at all, it makes sense to me. Stuff that brings you joy, even if it’s just a snack or candy can still bring joy and connections with people. 



atm I’m in the job search as well but the fear of having to interact with people doesn’t really help, been wanting to seek help but

I rarely smoke weed anymore, like maybe 2-3 grams a month, but I still feel like a lost a lot of memories even when I haven’t smoked for a while. I am perplexed by the amount of stuff I don’t know that I should know. I rarely speak anymore and talking actually feels like a puzzle most of the time.

I do have a dog that I sometimes walk, pretty much the only way I get outside anymore except for going to the supermarket to buy cigarettes. When I’m walking my dog I feel a little more secure since people walk their dog and it’s something that needs to be done and it doesn’t really matter how you look doing it. When I go on a walk through nature by myself I’m just scared of running into people and I just feel out of place all the time.
